provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: The template is chosen by component size rather than by the archived rule of most cells per colour. This deliberately fixes a generator-domain case: one fragment colour may be reused across up to three directions, and its total cell count can then exceed a 4-cell diamond template. Each single fragment has at most 3 cells, while the template has at least 4, so the size-based choice is unambiguous in the domain. It assumes fragments sit inside the template-anchored lattice cells and that chains of different groups do not overlap, both of which the constructor guarantees. Demonstrations are not used. I have not executed any tests. I found no contradictions between the fixtures and the uniform rule.
